title: payable
description: A payable is a short-term liability owed by a company to its creditors (suppliers or employees). Several types of payables are supported by Spendesk, e.g. Invoices, Credit Notes, Expense Claims, Physical card purchases, Single Use card purchases, Subscription card purchases, etc.

type.description:
Indicates the type of the payable. 

Type | Description |
---------|----------|
 `expenseClaim` | An expense claim submitted and approved | 
 `invoicePurchase` | An invoice to pay submitted and approved | 
 `creditNote` | A credit note submitted and approved |
  `singlePurchaseCard` | A purchase made with a single-use virtual card |
  `multiUseCard` | A purchase made with a multi-use virtual card | 
  `subscriptionCard` | A purchase made with a subscription virtual card |
  `physicalCard` | A purchase made with a physical card |
  `mileageAllowance` | A mileage expense submitted and approved |
  `perDiemAllowance` | A per diem expense submitted and approved |
  `reverseBill` | A refund or a late return (aka cash return) |"

version.description: The current version of this payable. This is incremented every time the payable is modified.

userId.description: The ID of the Spendesk user who created this payable.

companyId.description: The ID of the company (this could be a wallet or an entity).

appUrl.description: Link to this payable in the Spendesk web app.

costCenterId.description: The ID of the cost center, if available.

costCenterName.description: The name of the cost center, if available.

payableDate.description:
For expenses - this is the date of the expense.
For reversals - this is the date of the reversal.
In the `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

accountingDate.description:
This feature is not activated by default.
If activated, `accounting date` field allows accountants to override the original expense date.
In the `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

invoiceDueDate.description: The date the invoice is due. In the `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

functionalExchangeRate.description: If the payment was made in a foreign currency, this will be the exchange rate that was applied when the payment was made.

outstandingAmount.description: Portion of the payable amount not yet covered by allocations, in the payable currency minor units (e.g. cents for EUR and USD, but yen for JPY). Zero means fully allocated. Absent if allocation tracking is unavailable for this payable.

outstandingFunctionalAmount.description: Same as `outstandingAmount` but expressed in the company's functional currency minor units.

purchaseOrderNumber.description: Purchase order number linked to this invoice payable, if available.

referenceInvoiceNumber.description: Invoice number of an invoice that resulted in a credit note, if available.

exportedAt.description: The date this payable was first exported via an accounting export. In the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) date format.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of the creation of this payable. String containing a UTC datetime expressed in ISO 8601 format like `2023-05-12T14:06:40Z` (source `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601`).

commitmentCounterparty.description: The counterparty associated with the spending commitment, or null when unavailable. For expense claims, use its name as the merchant name only when type is supplier. counterparty is the employee being reimbursed; their accountPayable must not be used as a merchant creditor account.

id.description: Internal Spendesk ID of the account payable.

generalAccountCode.description: Accounting code of the account payable.

auxiliaryAccountCode.description: Auxiliary code of the account payable, if available.

counterparty.description: A payable is due to either a supplier or an employee.

allocatedAmount.description: Payable amount allocated to this settlement. Expressed in smallest units of the currency (e.g. cents for EUR and USD, but yen for JPY).

settlementId.description: The ID of the allocated settlement.

allocatedAmount.description: Payable amount allocated to expenses. Expressed in smallest units of the currency (e.g. cents for EUR and USD, but yen for JPY).
Payable amount allocated to reversals. Expressed in smallest units of the currency (e.g. cents for EUR and USD, but yen for JPY).

allocations.description: An array of allocations for the payable. An expense payable can have a settlement or a reversal payable allocated to it. A reversal payable can have a settlement or an expense payable allocated to it.

from.description: Start date of the amortisation period. In the ISO 8601 date-time format.

to.description: End date of the amortisation period. In the ISO 8601 date-time format.

amortisation.description: Amortisation details for the payable, if applicable.

analyticalProperties.description: Analytical fields and values of the payable.
analyticalProperties.title: analyticalProperties

bookkeepingStatus.description:
Status of the payable in the Spendesk flow. 

| Status | Description |
| ---|--- |
| `created` | Payable (approved expense) has been created. There is no accounting or supplier information on the payable in this state. |
| `prepared` | Payable has been prepared (enriched with accounting and supplier information) by an accountant. |
| `exported` | Payable has been exported to accounting |
| `failedExport` | Payable has failed to export to accounting via a native Spendesk integrations |
| `exportedManually` | Payable has been marked as exported manually by the accountant |
| `unprepared` | Payable has been sent back to Bookkeep>Prepare |
"
bookkeepingStatus.title: bookkeepingStatus

currency.description: If the payment was made in a foreign currency, this amount will be the one in the payment currency. Three-letter [ISO currency codes](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html).
currency.title: currency

expenseAccount.description: Expense account this line item is allocated to.

vatAccount.description: VAT account this line item is allocated to.

id.description: Reverse charge account Spendesk internal ID.

creditCode.description: Account code used to credit the reverse charge to.

debitCode.description: Account code used to debit the reverse charge to.

reverseChargeAccount.description: Reverse charge accounts can be used in place of VAT accounts. They always have a rate of 0%.

vatAmount.description: Amount of VAT calculated automatically or entered manually by the accountant. Expressed in smallest units of the currency (e.g. cents for EUR and USD, but yen for JPY).

vatAdjustmentAmount.description: Only exists when vatAmount was manually adjusted by the accountant. Is calculated as vatAmount - (netAmount * vatAccount.rate) and can be negative or positive. Expressed in smallest units of the currency (e.g. cents for EUR and USD, but yen for JPY).

netAmount.description: Net amount or the line iteam (grossAmount - vatAmount) Expressed in smallest units of the currency (e.g. cents for EUR and USD, but yen for JPY).

grossAmount.description: Gross amount of the line item (netAmount + vatAmount) Expressed in smallest units of the currency (e.g. cents for EUR and USD, but yen for JPY).

financial.description: Financial amounts of the line item

costCenterId.description: The ID of the cost center, if available.

costCenterName.description: The name of the cost center, if available.

analyticalProperties.description: Array of analytical properties for this line item.

priceAmount.description:
If the payment was made in a foreign currency, this amount will be the one in the payment currency.
Can contain a negative value in case of refunds.
Expressed in smallest units of the currency (e.g. cents for EUR and USD, but yen for JPY).
priceAmount.title: priceAmount
